                  PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS

                     TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT

                                1434 W. Fiournoy



RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use
District.

The purpose of the rezoning is to adaptively reuse a 3.5-story residential building. The
Applicant proposes to establish 2 existing, nonconforming dwelling units at the garden level of
the existing building containing 6 other dwelling units. No changes are proposed to the existing
structure of the building, which will remain the same size. The existing height of the building at
35.83' will remain. The property is a transit served location and is within 1,320 feet of the
Ashland CTA Bus Route #9. Zero parking spaces will be added for the two units.*

                       Building Height            36.5 feet (existing)
